keys: All lexicographically ordered surjections from four cipher symbols to three externally fixed plaintext letters
emission: uniform over the one or two cipher aliases of each plaintext letter
lm_only_comparator: Same 36 admissible keys; maximize LM plaintext probability without emission term. Heuristic decision only, not a normalized ciphertext model.
primary_checks: Each conditional cipher likelihood sums exactly to one
Uniform-prior joint mass sums exactly to one
Independent forward enumeration matches all 147456 inverse likelihood entries
Independent decision and risk recomputation matches all 4096 ciphertext rows
Key MAP, plaintext MAP and free/constrained Hamming optimize their respective losses
scope: Finite mathematical calibration with an invented rational language model. Not a Latin recovery trial, no new blinded validation, no Voynich translation or Kraken retraining.
interpretation_limits: Surjectivity and a fixed known alphabet change the regime relative to stage88; cannot claim this solves its unrestricted collapse
A sampled generating key/plaintext need not be MAP even under a correct generative model
MAP key, MAP plaintext, and Hamming-optimal decisions must remain distinct
All computed gains are model-expected probabilities, not real manuscript decoding accuracy
